content_of_post_to_comment: People always say, “I wish I were as strong as you.” No, you really don’t. You don’t want to know the kind of pain I went through to become this way. Don’t romanticize my strength. It came from surviving things you pray never find you.
comment: There’s a difference between strength built through growth and strength built through necessity. The hard part is that survival can create resilience, but it can also leave scars we rarely see. Maybe the question is how we honor strength without glorifying the suffering that produced it.
